construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch inside the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: One strict JSON object: schema_version, fixture_label, catalog, preferences, search, feedback, research. All fields shown in example_input.json are required; max_price alone may be null. Unknown fields, duplicate IDs, nonfinite numbers, booleans as numbers, unknown feedback product references and invalid bounds are rejected.
shared_schema.output: One JSON object: schema_version, fixture_label, status, stages. stages contains interests, semantic, feedback, web in pipeline order. Each stage carries a stage discriminator and shares product_id, feedback_id and source_id references.
shared_schema.validation: validate is the shared validator for input, each stage handoff and the final envelope. Evidence is checked against supplied catalog, feedback and snapshots. Output validation never reinvokes the embedding callable.
shared_schema.errors: CLI validation, argument, JSON, UTF-8 and filesystem errors print one JSON object with status error and exit 2. Successful execution prints one JSON object and exits 0.
shared_schema.bounds: At most 1000 entries per input array, 10000 characters per text field, prices 0..1000000000, feedback integer ratings 1..5, limits 1..1000, research findings per theme 1..20.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Only validated ranked recommendations enter the search index. Explicit exclusions and budget remain absolute. Preference evidence propagates into each match.
Only matched product IDs select feedback. Search top_k and minimum relevance narrow downstream insights.
Validated themes, product IDs and every supporting original feedback ID create research queries and traceable findings. No feedback means no queries or findings.

behavior.interests: Case-insensitive exact interest/tag matches, matched-interest fraction ranking, ID tie-breaks. Unmatched products are omitted unless interests are empty. Excluded IDs are exact; excluded tags are case-insensitive. Budget is inclusive; max_results limits the handoff.
behavior.semantic: Deterministic Unicode-normalized token inverted index plus a small explicit synonym dictionary. Default relevance is query-term coverage; ties use preference score then product ID. Zero scores never match, even when min_score is zero.
behavior.embedding: Optional run_pipeline(data, embedder=callable), called on the query and each eligible product text. Callable returns a finite nonzero list or tuple with fixed dimension, maximum 4096 components and absolute component value <= 1e100. Scores are 70% token coverage plus 30% nonnegative cosine similarity, rounded to eight decimals. Tests inject local fixtures; there is no live provider.
behavior.feedback: Deduplication uses product ID plus NFKC/casefold/punctuation-and-whitespace-normalized text. First occurrence supplies verbatim text and rating; all original IDs are retained. Same text across different products stays separate. Fixed themes may overlap; unknown content becomes other. Counts are deduplicated; sentiment is rating-derived.
behavior.web: Offline allowlisted URL snapshot ingestion only. Exact case-insensitive DNS-host allowlist, HTTPS only, no credentials, IP literals, nondefault ports, backslashes or whitespace. Fragments and default port are canonicalized away. First canonical URL wins; rejected snapshots carry reasons. Theme-keyword sentence retrieval yields verbatim excerpts and source-content SHA-256 provenance. Findings rank by theme-term coverage then source ID; quotes require text evidence, not title-only matches.
behavior.research_interpretation: Research provides general theme context, explicitly not product verification or causal claims. Original product/feedback links indicate why a finding was retrieved, not that the source discusses that specific product. Other themes produce a traceable query but no inferred findings.
behavior.synthetic_data: All supplied products, feedback, snapshots and example domains are clearly labeled synthetic.
behavior.determinism: No clocks, randomness, network calls or writes in implementation. Input and source order decide documented deduplication ties; ranking ties are stable.

included: Single integrated CLI and importable pipeline
Small synonym-based search and optional injected embeddings
Feedback deduplication, fixed themes and verbatim supporting excerpts
Offline allowlisted research ingestion, retrieval and findings
Synthetic fixtures and standard-library unittest suite
excluded: Network fetching, redirects, crawling and live web research
General-purpose semantic understanding or learned sentiment
Enterprise persistence, authentication, scheduling or production deployment
Truth verification of supplied research snapshots

test_outcomes.cli_stdout: Exactly one JSON object, containing all four validated stage outputs
coverage: All four stages and end-to-end deterministic execution
Exclusions, budget, ranking, synonyms, limits and provenance propagation
Injected embedding fixtures, dimensionality, finiteness, zero and tiny vectors
Feedback deduplication, sentiment, themes, cross-product distinction and excerpts
Allowlist URL tricks, canonical duplicates, empty inputs and unrelated sources
Tampered handoffs and final provenance rejection
CLI success, arguments, file errors, malformed JSON, invalid schema and encoding
